status_note: Reproduces on 55.0.0, the latest release. [apache/datafusion#24432](https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/24432) (closed by PR #24433, 2026-08-20) changed grouped float `MIN`/`MAX`, but 55.0.0 still gives these results; no open issue covers them. Main not checked.
title: Grouped `MIN` of `+inf` values is `f64::MAX`, and grouped `MAX` skips a NaN that ungrouped `MAX` returns
summary: Grouped `MIN` and `MAX` of doubles start from `±f64::MAX`: a group of `+inf` values has `MIN` `1.7976931348623157e308`. Grouped `MAX` of `{NaN, 1.0}` is `1.0`, though ungrouped `MAX` of the same values is NaN under DataFusion's own order.
repro: `select k, min(v), max(v) from (values (1, cast('inf' as double)), (1, cast('inf' as double))) t(k, v) group by k` gives `1, 1.7976931348623157e308, inf`.

`select k, min(v), max(v) from (values (1, cast('NaN' as double)), (1, 1.0)) t(k, v) group by k` gives `1, 1.0, 1.0`; `select min(v), max(v) from (values (cast('NaN' as double)), (1.0)) t(v)` gives `1.0, NaN`.
found_by: audit of DataFusion's limits on the shared path (2026-11-08)
